notes.title: Hell Architect is changing for you
notes.content:
Hello Sinners, 

We are still working on the full version of Hell Architect. Thanks to your feedback, we've been able to fix a large number of bugs - if you find any, be sure to let us know!

But that's not all, because soon some changes will appear in Hell Architect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38893617/8153540d4bd29e06c7060e79ab2db5dcff3f6cd4.png

What exactly?

[olist]
 Random Events - you will have the opportunity to get something for free (of course it will not be that easy!), You will have to take a risk to get an unique item. In one sentence: it will be more difficult, but also more interesting! 😈
 Perk system - there will be talents (almost like in the Got Talent program) that you can buy and use 😎
 We are changing Sandbox to Hell Architect Mode - you will deal with adapting to use, uninhabited circles of hell, each map will save information about achievements on it, here you will find events and perks. Shortly: we will add a goal to make the gameplay more attractive 🔥
 We are changing the main menu 🥳
 MAC version will be available 🍏
 Mysterious new legends will come 👑
 New hellish music for your souls 🎷
 And finally: the rebalancing of costs 🤑
[/olist]


Of course, that's not all! There will be new decorations in Hell, and we'll fix translations that translators are currently working on.

You can expect this UPDATE this year! Follow us - thanks to this you will not miss the updates 🥳🥳🥳🥳

notes.title: Hell Architect Prologue: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello Sinners!


We are happy to inform that we make first update for Hell Architect Prologue 😈😈😈 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38893617/021419178126205494979ee74ed7a86608d593e8.png

What's change?

ADDED: 

 option to torture/put to work sinners with low needs levels
 sims will now leave a structure to complete other tasks when no resources for that structure's process are available
 a button displaying the full game version's features
 removed loss of the type of need a sim is working on at the moment
 possibility to place sinner in a structure with no resources



FIX: 

 sound looping after a sinner's death
 sinners blocked in a structure when no path is available
 default volume of some of the annoying sinners' screams lowered
 volume adjustment not affecting the Prologue intro
 no new construction possible in place of a previously deconstructed structure
 dig and build tasks cancelling on their own
 issues when returning to the Main Menu after completing the Tutorial (unresponsive buttons)
 text localization missing for resources when building a structure
 improved efficiency when choosing sims for tasks (now prioritizes the closest sims)
 deselecting sims from structures (when working outside a structure)



Wish a lot of fun and hellish regards, 
Woodland Games Team 😈

notes.title: Woodland Games Discord Channel
notes.content:
Hello Woodland Games Community!

You've probably noticed by now that there's a lot going on at Woodland Games these days. We hope you take it as a good sign, because for us all that news are GOOD 😉

Our projects are evolve: Hell Architect, Taxi Simulator, Autopsy and Ubran Explorer. Each of our games has seen quite a milestone, so it's time to talk about it.

On this occasion we invite you to our Discord  where you can make to us AMA session whenever you want 😉 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35644117/ed148fb63291ede80bfffbae3f96860ba9963835.png

Especially that:
- Kickstarter Hell Architect will be launched soon (stay tuned!)
- Devlog Autopsy Simulator will start in a days
- The city in Taxi Simulator is almost done (really!)
- Urban Explorer is just starting in cooperation with Pyramid Games – soon you will be able to make #urbex also at home 😉 

A lot? There will be even more, so join Discord now!
